objects.description: One observation put on record — what happened during a stretch of work, what got in the way, and what would be worth building because of it. Append-only: an insight is never edited or removed, and the way it grows is a note beside it.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers. Set when the row is written; a create request that carries one has it ignored.

fields.name: repo
fields.description: Which body of work this observation concerned, named the way the people doing it name it. Empty when the work was not scoped to one.

fields.name: subject_id
fields.description: The thing the observation is about, as the mounting domain identifies it. Empty for an observation about the work itself rather than about anything it produced.

fields.name: context_id
fields.description: Which revision or working copy of the subject was open when this was captured. Empty when the subject has no revisions, or none was open.

fields.name: source
fields.description: Whether this was recorded by something automated or typed by a person. It decides how much the reader should trust the wording, not how much they should trust the observation.

fields.name: summary
fields.description: A short account of what happened or was observed. The one thing an insight cannot be filed without.

fields.name: tags
fields.description: Comma-separated free text for grouping, such as "risk, decision". Deliberately not a closed set: nothing yet needs to filter on one, and a premature enum would refuse the word somebody actually wanted.

fields.name: challenges
fields.description: The repetitive work and friction this stretch ran into. Free prose, because the point is to capture it before it is understood well enough to categorise.

fields.name: suggestions
fields.description: The shortcuts, tooling or changes this stretch suggests are worth building. Free prose, for the same reason.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the observation was recorded. The only ordering a feed of these has.

indexes.name: repo
indexes.description: Filtering a feed down to one body of work.

indexes.name: subject
indexes.description: Filtering a feed down to one subject, which is how a screen showing one thing lists what has been observed about it.

indexes.name: created
indexes.description: The newest-first ordering every listing uses.

objects.description: A follow-up remark on an insight already on record. It is how an observation grows — someone confirming it, adding detail, or reporting that it happened again — without filing a second insight that repeats the first one's summary.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers. Set when the row is written.

fields.name: insight_id
fields.description: The insight this remark is attached to. Required, and it must already exist: a note about nothing is a note nobody will ever read.

fields.name: source
fields.description: Whether this remark was recorded by something automated or typed by a person.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the remark was recorded. Notes read oldest-first, unlike the insights feed, because a thread is read top to bottom.

indexes.name: insight
indexes.description: Reading every remark on one insight, in order.
